verses.text: [“]Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

xrefs.text: The prophet is Ephraim’s watchman, along with my God, yet the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths. Hostility is in the house of his God!
The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.
Now hear this, O leaders of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and pervert all that is right,
Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.

verses.text: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.

xrefs.text: All their evil appears at Gilgal, for there I hated them. I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.
Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. In darkness they do their works and say, “Who sees us, and who will know?”
Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.

verses.text: I know all about Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now, O Ephraim, you have turned to prostitution; Israel is defiled.

xrefs.text: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Though Ephraim multiplied the altars for sin, they became his altars for sinning.
When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.
Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians— warriors

verses.text: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.

xrefs.text: My people consult their wooden idols, and their divining rods inform them. For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.
By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.
Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land: “There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.

verses.text: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; even Judah stumbles with them.

xrefs.text: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them, yet they do not return to the LORD their God; despite all this, they do not seek Him.
Because you have followed the path of your sister, I will put her cup into your hand.’
“Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.”
For though a righteous man may fall seven times, he still gets up; but the wicked stumble in bad times.
His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?

verses.text: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.

xrefs.text: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?

“What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.

verses.text: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.

xrefs.text: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.
But as a woman may betray her husband, so you have betrayed Me, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD.
I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘None of My words will be delayed any longer. The message I speak will be fulfilled, declares the Lord GOD.’”

verses.text: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; raise the battle cry in Beth-aven: Lead on, O Benjamin!

xrefs.text: Though you prostitute yourself, O Israel, may Judah avoid such guilt! Do not journey to Gilgal, do not go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear on oath, ‘As surely as the LORD lives!’
Blow the ram’s horn in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain! Let all who dwell in the land tremble, for the Day of the LORD is coming; indeed, it is near—
They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt; He will punish their sins.
Then Samuel went to Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.
Announce in Judah, proclaim in Jerusalem, and say: “Blow the ram’s horn throughout the land. Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves and let us flee to the fortified cities.’

verses.text: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

xrefs.text: But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, overtake your fathers? They repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.’”
Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird, with no birth, no pregnancy, and no conception.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

verses.text: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.

xrefs.text: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker, which was set up by your ancestors to mark the inheritance you shall receive in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
To start a quarrel is to release a flood; so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.

verses.text: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.

xrefs.text: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their counsel. Therefore I will make you a desolation, and your inhabitants an object of contempt; you will bear the scorn of the nations.
A people you do not know will eat the produce of your land and of all your toil. All your days you will be oppressed and crushed.
Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom might revert to the house of David.
At that time Menahem, starting from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in its vicinity, because they would not open their gates. So he attacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.

Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.

verses.text: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.

xrefs.text: For the moth will devour them like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will last forever, My salvation through all generations.”
So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
When dawn came the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant so that it withered.
If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.
Surely the Lord GOD helps Me. Who is there to condemn Me? See, they will all wear out like a garment; the moths will devour them.

verses.text: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.

xrefs.text: So Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove— calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria.
For this is what the LORD says: “Your injury is incurable; your wound is grievous.
Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom.
Ephraim feeds on the wind and pursues the east wind all day long; he multiplies lies and violence; he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.
Yes, it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim will be seized with shame; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.

verses.text: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.

xrefs.text: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it passes through, with no one to rescue them.
So like a lion I will pounce on them; like a leopard I will lurk by the path.
Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl in his den if he has caught nothing?

verses.text: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.”

xrefs.text: O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me—
